heading: About UKPSC Decoded
subtitle: Built by aspirants, for aspirants. We believe quality exam preparation should be accessible to everyone.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.quote: Making quality Uttarakhand exam preparation accessible to every aspirant, regardless of geography or budget.
mission.body: Uttarakhand aspirants often struggle to find quality, structured preparation material — especially for the state-specific portions. Coaching centers are concentrated in Dehradun and Haldwani, leaving thousands of aspirants in remote areas without access. UKPSC Decoded bridges that gap through digital content, a comprehensive guidebook, and an engaged community.

timeline.title: YouTube Channel Started
timeline.description: Began uploading Uttarakhand GK videos to help aspirants prepare for free.

timeline.title: Telegram Community Launched
timeline.description: Created a dedicated space for daily MCQs, current affairs, and peer discussion.

timeline.title: Book Manuscript Completed
timeline.description: 28 chapters covering the entire UKPSC syllabus — history, geography, polity, culture, and more.

timeline.title: Website + Courses Launching
timeline.description: Full-stack digital platform with PYQ tracker, courses, test series, and mentorship programs.
